system.requirements: You are taking persistent fire damage.
system.description: You can draw the heat of a lingering flame inward until its last trace gutters out.
system.effect: End one instance of persistent fire damage on yourself. This does not remove its source, prevent a new application, or extinguish an independently burning object.
system.automation: [EFFECT: End Persistent Fire Damage; LIMIT: encounter]

rules.error: "EFFECT:" is not a feature keyword: write TRAIT, SIZE, SPEED, VIGOR, SENSES, LANGUAGE, POINT, MANEUVER, TALENT, CHOICE, AURA, EFFECT, or `[<Constellation> trained]`; an effect goes in `[EFFECT <tag>: ...]`
